title: XAIHT/Tlamatini
summary: Speak an idea. Build the real thing. Tlamatini brings AI to code, 3D worlds and hardware: voice, live editor tutoring, 86 workflow agents, 110 tools, Unreal Engine, Blender, STM32, ESP32 and MCP. Open source on Windows, with local control and cloud reasoning. Full experience requires Ollama Pro+

title: PatriceA/octipus
summary: An open-source, self-hosted assistant that delegates real work to a swarm of specialist AI agents.

title: sunilgentyala/LaptopAI-Agent
summary: Fully local, privacy-first autonomous AI agent for laptop management — LangGraph reasoning loop, Ollama local LLM, ChromaDB RAG, MCP server, SHA-256 chained audit log. Zero API keys. Zero cloud calls.

title: Dragonswithin/happy-bot-kde
summary: Happy Bot: an AI search bar for the KDE Plasma 6 panel. Type anything and it finds files, answers from the web, and acts on your desktop through tools (MCP), with any local or hosted LLM.

title: cmcoffee/gohort
summary: Your agent has agents. A self-hosted, local-first AI agent platform in one Go binary: agents hand work to specialists and build the tools, agents and apps they lack, with sandboxed tools and credentials the model never sees.

title: erjonb19/governed-clinical-agent
summary: Capability-based security runtime for AI agents with default-deny tool mediation, policy enforcement, prompt-injection detection, and compliance-grade audit logging.

title: Aparsa40/local-ai-assistant
summary: A Persian-first, local-first AI workspace with a FastAPI backend, lightweight browser UI, SQLite persistence, and replaceable local/cloud model providers.  The long-term direction is a provider-agnostic assistant with controlled knowledge access, online/offline execution paths, permissioned tools and connectors, and an auditable AI Librarian

title: codyrs82/Edgecoder
summary: AI coding assistant that runs on your own machines, with a Bitcoin-settled network of hosts for extra compute. Source-available (BUSL-1.1).

title: Orkeon/orkeon
summary: AI agent teams that stay inside the lines, in .NET: every file, endpoint and budget an agent may use is declared, then enforced by the runtime. Describe a team in YAML, TypeScript (.ork.ts) or C# - one runtime executes all three, and the team you tuned is the one you integrate, without a rewrite.

title: tobocop2/lilbee
summary: A local model engine with a search engine and web crawler built in. Run your coding agents on your own GPUs, and get cited answers from your files, code, and the sites you crawl. One executable.

title: codewhale-hq/Codewhale
summary: An open-source coding agent for your terminal, written in Rust. It works with any model, can split one task across several agents, and every line of it is yours to read.

title: AprilB3V/CharacterLife
summary: A mind kernel for AI characters that live on their own, remember what happened, and keep receipts. Any OpenAI-compatible model, local Ollama, zero runtime dependencies.

title: jiangding01/islet-translate
summary: 网页双语阅读 Chrome 扩展：整页双语对照、划词翻译、英文单词英美音标；支持 Google、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Gemini 及本地模型，密钥只存本地。A Chrome extension for bilingual web reading: whole-page bilingual translation, selection translation with UK/US phonetics, Google/OpenAI/DeepSeek/Gemini and local models; your API keys stay on your device.

title: cdmx-in/kera
summary: Self-hosted AI chat for teams. Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible model, knowledge search, tools, and Cowork tasks that run on their own. One Go binary and Postgres.

title: pratikgh0se/lossless-handoff
summary: Claude Code hooks for lossless context: a handoff before every auto-compaction, a per-project decisions list, and recall of exact earlier words (hybrid keyword + local semantic search). Based on the LCM paper (arXiv:2605.04050).

title: NAIROlab-ke/Strathmore-School_AI-App-Builders-Program_Nov-Dec-Holidays-2026
summary: November/December 2026 Holiday Program for www.strathmore.ac.ke students. A course on building AI apps for typical AI paradigms (e.g. Multimodal, RAG, tool use, AI agents, Text-to-SQL) using opensource AI components/stacks.

title: Muvon/octohub
summary: High-performance LLM proxy: one OpenAI-style API over 20+ providers, with multi-tenant keys, full request logging, and usage analytics. Built in Rust.

title: MdHashim1011/omnitrix
summary: Delegate tasks from Claude Code to the AI accounts you already pay for. Claude plans the work, and omnitrix routes each task to Codex, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, a local model or any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible API while tracking each account's usage.

title: gonzaloMorenoc/Mnemo
summary: AI-powered QA memory: keeps each project's QA knowledge across handovers. Explainable CI failure triage, semantic project memory, test plans and Playwright tests with human review, Ed25519-signed verifiable certificates. Swappable LLM (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Ollama).

title: NexPathArchitect/mon-brain
summary: Local, offline note brain on Ollama: organize / translate-summary / review. Data never leaves your machine. All rights reserved.
